Section 3. Quality and efficiency of the implementation

compliance_checklist.description: Scope compliance: The application must be in scope, corresponding wholly or in part to the topic description against which it has been submitted. Out-of-scope applications must be identified and the reason stated.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: The activities proposed must have an exclusive focus on civil applications. Activities intended to be used in military applications or aimed to serve military purposes cannot be funded.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): The proposal must confirm whether hESC are involved. If yes, a justification for the necessity of hESC to achieve the scientific objectives must be provided, or a statement that it cannot be assessed due to lack of information.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: The proposal must confirm whether human embryos are involved. If yes, an explanation of how the human embryos will be used in the project must be provided.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: The proposal must not include activities that aim at human cloning for reproductive purposes; intend to modify the heritable genetic heritage of human beings; intend to create human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement; or lead to the destruction of human embryos. The evaluator must confirm whether any such activities are present.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding for third-country participants: Any third-country participant or international organisation not listed in the General Annex to the Main Work Programme may only receive funding exceptionally, if their participation is essential for carrying out the project. The evaluator must identify such participants and assess the justification.

Scope assessment: the application must be 'in scope' because it corresponds, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it has been submitted. If partly out of scope, this must be reflected in scoring and explained in comments.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: third country participants or international organisations not listed in the General Annex to the Main Work Programme may only receive funding if their participation is essential for carrying out the project (e.g. outstanding expertise, unique know-how, research infrastructure, geographical environments, data access). Evaluator must list concerned applicants and requested grant amount with justification.

Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): the proposal must declare whether it involves use of hESC. If yes, the evaluator must assess whether such use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives, or state if this cannot be assessed due to lack of information.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: the proposal must declare whether it involves the use of human embryos. If yes, the evaluator must explain how human embryos will be used in the project.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: proposals must not include activities that aim at human cloning for reproductive purposes; intend to modify the genetic heritage of human beings in a heritable way (excepting cancer treatment of gonads); intend to create human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement including via somatic cell nuclear transfer; or lead to the destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: the activities proposed must have an exclusive focus on civil applications. Activities intended to be used in military applications or that aim to serve military purposes cannot be funded.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications
